meta.selector_method: md5(content_item_version_id::text || '|phase_c_2026_07_27') ascending, computed in Postgres via execute_sql against Production; FRQ items ordered long-form-first then short-form within each subject stratum (both by hash ascending) to help meet the >=10 long/investigative floor; quotas apportioned by the Hamilton/largest-remainder method, proportional to each family's/subject's eligible pool size, capped at pool size, with deterministic tie-break by (-remainder, key name).

Physics: AP Physics C: Electricity and Magnetism

meta.eligibility_sql: WITH latest_decision AS (SELECT d.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY content_item_version_id ORDER BY COALESCE(submitted_at, created_at) DESC, content_review_decision_id DESC) AS rn FROM app.content_review_decisions d), eligible_civ AS (SELECT civ.id AS content_item_version_id, civ.content_item_id, civ.status, civ.review_status, ld.tutor_decision, ld.content_review_decision_id FROM app.content_item_versions civ JOIN latest_decision ld ON ld.content_item_version_id = civ.id AND ld.rn = 1 WHERE ld.tutor_decision IN ('approve','approve_with_edits') AND civ.status IN ('reviewed_approved','published') AND (civ.review_status IS NULL OR civ.review_status IN ('question_review_approved','tutor_review_pending'))) ... joined to app.content_items / app.exam_pack_versions / app.exam_packs / app.subjects for subject, then to app.frq_criteria (learner_facing_text non-empty => usable) or app.mcq_choices (>=2 choices, exactly 1 is_correct => usable).

owner_decisions_applied.decision: Treat the latest content_review_decision per content_item_version_id as authoritative, ordered by COALESCE(submitted_at, created_at) DESC, because content_review_decisions.supersedes_id is populated on 0 of 765 rows and cannot be used as the prompt's literal 'non-superseded decision' signal.
owner_decisions_applied.decided_by: derived (no owner input required; schema fact)

owner_decisions_applied.decision: Exclude content_item_versions whose review_status indicates a genuine reopened/pending state: ap_reader_pending, difficulty_discussion, modification_reserved, excluded, answer_tutor_review_pending. Also exclude status in (draft, assigned, retired, changes_requested, reviewed_disapproved) regardless of review_status.
owner_decisions_applied.decided_by: Product Owner, this session (strict interpretation confirmed before the review_status='tutor_review_pending' relaxation below)

owner_decisions_applied.decision: INCLUDE content_item_versions with status IN (reviewed_approved, published) AND a recorded tutor_decision IN (approve, approve_with_edits) EVEN WHEN review_status still reads 'tutor_review_pending'. Verified against a concrete case (AP Chemistry: 29 reviewed_approved MCQs matched the owner's independent count exactly; the 12 reviewed_approved FRQs left review_status stale at tutor_review_pending after decisioning). Treated as stale/unset pipeline metadata, not a genuine reopen, and applied consistently across all subjects for consistency (not only Chemistry).

meta.known_content_pipeline_defect_not_fixed_: AP Calculus BC has zero eligible FRQs under any interpretation used here (15 content_item_versions are status=assigned with no tutor decision at all; 1 is published+tutor_review_pending with no decision). AP Calculus AB recovered to 12 eligible only via the review_status relaxation above. This is a real, unresolved content-pipeline gap (items never routed to tutor review), not a query artifact -- flagged for Product Owner/content-ops follow-up, not fixed by Phase C.
